name: favourite-first-click-five-profiles
description:
The host document that showed the flash: six spaces on five profiles, the Default profile with two spaces and nine favourites on real origins, one of which (clockify) other profiles share. On a fresh launch the first click on the Reddit tile swapped five of the nine tiles to letter plates for half a second while the four tiles other profiles also know kept their icons, and one push brought every icon back. That split is the shape of one push whose favourites are the Default profile's but whose icon scope is another profile's cache.

The scenario wraps window.atriumSetSidebar before the click and records, for every push, the icon scope and the pinned favourite ids the push carried, plus a MutationObserver log of the tile ids and img states. The measurement is the number of distinct icon scopes the pushes carried across the click: one means the scope never left this profile.

With the fix, a rebuild adopts the loaded img nodes of the tree it replaces, so the nodes marked before the click are the nodes on screen after it whatever the renderer's image cache did in between.

actions.note: first paint, the sidebar announces itself, the site fetch fills the Default cache

actions.expression: (() => { const pin = [...document.querySelectorAll('.favgrid')].find(g => !g.closest('.railpane')); if (!pin) { return 'no-pin'; } const tiles = [...pin.querySelectorAll('.fav')]; return String(tiles.length === 9 && tiles.filter(f => f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok')).length >= 6); })()
actions.note: VACUITY GUARD: the nine Default tiles are up and at least six carry a painted icon before the click

actions.expression: (() => { const pinOf = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.favgrid')].find(g => !g.closest('.railpane')); const tileState = () => { const pin = pinOf(); return pin ? [...pin.querySelectorAll('.fav')].map(f => { const i = f.querySelector('.fvimg'); return (f.dataset.favId || '').replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').slice(0, 12) + '=' + (i ? (i.classList.contains('ok') ? 'ok' : 'img') : 'none'); }).join(',') : 'no-pin'; }; window.__pushes = []; const orig = window.atriumSetSidebar; window.atriumSetSidebar = function(snap) { const favs = (snap && snap.favorites) || []; window.__pushes.push(String(snap && snap.iconScope).slice(0, 8) + '#' + favs.map(f => String(f.id || '').replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').slice(0, 12)).join(',')); return orig.apply(this, arguments); }; window.__dom = [tileState()]; new MutationObserver(() => { const s = tileState(); if (window.__dom[window.__dom.length - 1] !== s) { window.__dom.push(s); } }).observe(document.body, {subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['src', 'class', 'data-fav-id']}); [...(pinOf() || document).querySelectorAll('.fvimg.ok')].forEach(i => { i.__carry = 1; }); return 'hooked:' + typeof orig; })()
actions.note: records the icon scope and favourite ids of every push, and every distinct tile state, from here on. Every painted pinned img is marked, so a later eval can tell an adopted node from a fresh one
drops any suggestion popup the activation left open
THE MEASUREMENT: the Reddit tile, row 1 column 3 of the pinned grid (three columns at this width)
gate: the click reached a tile
the page commits over the real network, every push lands
recorded: icon scope # pinned favourite ids, per push
recorded: every distinct tile state the observer saw
THE ASSERTION: distinct icon scopes across every push after the hook
THE ASSERTION: a later state dropped an img that the first state had

actions.expression: (() => { const pin = [...document.querySelectorAll('.favgrid')].find(g => !g.closest('.railpane')); const imgs = pin ? [...pin.querySelectorAll('.fvimg.ok')] : []; return imgs.filter(i => i.__carry === 1).length + '/' + imgs.length; })()
actions.note: THE ASSERTION: painted pinned imgs that are the very nodes marked before the click / painted pinned imgs now
